assessments.mechanism: Sleep-like spontaneous/noise replay with local plasticity to recover old-task structure and reduce interference.

assessments.o_comparison: O runtime replay/journaling is deterministic execution replay, not neural sleep/rehearsal learning; no SRC mechanism was found.
